title: Show the saved product brand across the website
summary: Preserve selected brands in website product cards and render the same brand logos used by Expo.

changes.detail: apiToCard no longer drops the saved brand, allowing website product lists to show the selected identity.
Render matching brand logos on standard, collection and recommendation cards. Share registry requests across cards and refresh on window focus after cache expiry.
Remember failed logo URLs to avoid repeatedly alternating between unavailable remote and bundled logos.
Admin selection explains which brand will appear on the app and site after saving. Expo already preserves the API brand and renders ProductBrandMark; no mobile code changed.
